notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Orthion.
description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Ganax with haste.
Put each Ganax token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Ganax triggers five times, for a total of thirty triggers, creating thirty Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate ten Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{U}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, you may then target any other creature using Orthion's ability.
